title: Evaluation of a multimodal prehabilitation program prior to total hip and knee replacement: A prospective randomized study
summary:
This prospective randomized study examines the effectiveness of a
prehabilitation program for patients receiving hip or knee prostheses. The subjects are divided into three groups—two intervention groups and one control group. The intervention groups undergo an eight-week or four-week preparatory program, each consisting of eight modules. The focus is on knowledge acquisition, preoperative muscle building through a training program, ergonomic and physiotherapeutic instructions regarding postoperative behavioral measures, and mental training to improve the training effect and reduce preoperative anxiety and tension.
Data is collected using standardized scores, knowledge tests, and functional tests before and after surgery. Evaluations are carried out using questionnaires. These are completed before the start of the program, repeatedly during the program, and after completion of the program.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Aged 18 or over
• German language level B2 CEFR
• Primary hip or knee total endoprosthesis implantation planned
• Osteoarthritis as underlying disease
Exclusion criteria:
• Age under 18
• Language level below B2 CERF, as the instructions and explanations in the training videos are in German.
• Total hip or knee replacement
• Total hip or knee replacement
• Dementia
• No or insufficient access to the content offered via an
electronic device (e.g., computer or tablet)
